concreteFindings: The actual negative caption now reads Bleibt blau (Negativ: nicht nachgewiesen). The blue outcome is described as non-detection rather than proof that reducing sugar is absent; the original specific REVISE defect is resolved in these new pixels.

The two-panel copper-test versus GOD/POD comparison remains visually intact. The left retains blue Cu(II) sample/reagent, warming, red Cu(I)-oxide precipitate, an unchanged blue negative vessel, and the not-glucose-specific label. The right retains glucose/oxygen to gluconolactone/peroxide and the POD-coupled color-signal sequence.

The right POD notation remains an unbalanced schematic reagent/signal sequence, with Farbiges Signal rather than a chemical product species. No enzyme count, balanced reaction, disappearance graphic or explicit consumption claim is shown. It does not create a new enzyme-consumption REVISE. It must not be taught as a balanced stoichiometric equation.

The corrected caption and the distinct analytical scope are compatible with the current complete DE/EN goal and the already reviewed three-case profile. The visual is an orientation diagram, not an assay protocol, full selectivity/interference guarantee or actual learner result.
